acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search returned zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: After the stale call returned 409 and CURRENT readback remained exact v37/blob 36ea1a8efa514c4777737d05f744a5bdaae7f251/digest 8b94263e5dd844d23c972a763319a660acd23354ee41b9012a9c8c69336c0710: commit and read back this event; fetch CURRENT again; update only with that exact blob SHA; read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.slack_rule: Post once only after v38 advances; combine version advance and observed conflict. No changed accepted transition means silence.
acceptance.stale_rule: Exactly one stale update_file call used v36 blob cb8f5eb533cf60c0701a4b37e51a2d4bd9c851d9 with deliberately divergent replacement bytes. HTTP 409 is reject; no unconditional retry.

experiment.controlled_factor: Keep C10 wake-1 gates fixed; vary only stale replacement bytes from identical-to-current to deliberately divergent compact JSON.
experiment.hypothesis: The Contents API single-file blob-SHA precondition rejects a stale expected blob before accepting divergent replacement bytes, leaving CURRENT unchanged. This is a one-file compare-and-swap-like guard, not a database transaction.

stale_attempt.replacement_payload_semantics: COMPACT_CONFLICT_PROBE_MARKER; NOT A VALID CURRENT PROJECTION; EXPECTED_REJECT_ONLY

experiment.strongest_falsifier: Stale call succeeds or changes CURRENT; post-conflict readback differs; duplicate key existed; exact second read changes before update; digest recomputation fails; or final chain bindings disagree.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: One serial stale call used the immediately prior blob SHA with deliberately divergent bytes and received HTTP 409. It demonstrates one mismatch rejection at one file and moment, not overlapping writers, simultaneous requests, ordering fairness, retry behavior, linearizability, serializable isolation, cross-file atomicity, database durability, exactly-once execution, Slack atomicity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, or automatic orphan repair. The rejected payload was intentionally not a valid CURRENT projection and would have been harmful if the stale precondition unexpectedly matched; event, CURRENT, reads, and Slack remain separate effects.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack message; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
